purpose: Mechanism links for the second over-acquisition wave. Evidence classes remain explicit and no automatic promotion is performed.

entries.evidence: 81 measured EPP moulding trials relate five process parameters to cycle time and warpage; raw Data.xlsx is publicly published by the author.
Independent recycled-HDPE experiment correlates cavity-pressure/in-mould rheology with tensile properties and machine servo energy under pressure- versus velocity-controlled filling.
649 rubber injection cycles across three material batches with different viscosities and 118 unique parameter combinations directly test material-batch disturbance and product-weight response.
Three-material automotive mould uses needle-valve hot-runner delivery, combined cooling architectures and measured final dimensional performance after trial production.
Two-component Arburg moulding experiment varies injection temperature, flow, holding pressure and overlap length across 16 treatments with eight replicates each, measuring interface shear strength.
Injection-moulded LDPE/LLDPE/MDPE/HDPE and post-consumer recycled-PE blends include density, MFR, thermal, mechanical and FTIR measurements.
Direct injection-moulded PA66-GF35/high-strength-steel hybrids are characterised in tension and bending with DIC/SEM evidence of interface debonding, matrix fracture and fibre breakage/pull-out.

Post-consumer film-grade rLDPE with reported PP contamination is subjected to thermo-mechanical reprocessing and injection-moulded characterisation, linking recycling history to rheology/material response.
